en: AI Nutrition Coach works fully without AI. Adding one is a choice, and it stays yours.
In Settings, under Your AI, you pick one choice at a time.
No AI is the default, and the app is complete without it: you pick a match, or type it.
If the person who runs your server turned it on, this server's AI needs no key. The server adds its own, and it never reaches your browser.
Or bring your own key, for any OpenAI-compatible service.
It is kept in your encrypted store, and read only after you unlock.
It is bound to the host you saved it for. Point the app somewhere else, and the old key is not sent there.
Choosing an AI sends nothing by itself.
By default, every photo asks first, and names the host it would go to.
Not now, and nothing is sent. If you prefer, you can agree once per host instead.
Say yes, and the photo is shrunk, with its location and camera details removed.
The request always has the same shape: the model name, a fixed instruction, and the photo.
Not your name, not your history, not your other plates.
An AI helps in three places, each with its own yes.
Recognising a photo, reading a meal you describe, and the coach's notes and answers.
When the AI is busy, it says so plainly, with no countdown, and your meal still lands.
A model that runs on the device is planned.
Your AI, your call. The guide is in the docs, under Your AI.
